answers.acts: It publishes what it sells, delivers a system once its set-up is paid with an order, offers the licence, bids on a tender, and switches a system off when the licence ends or is not paid for. It takes no requests.

boundary.why: The technology on offer is the outside world's: which tasks systems can do, at what price, in what time, with what error and what terms, as vendors beyond the town sell them. It is a fact about the world beyond the town, as world prices are, held in the profile with its source; this module stands for it at the world's edge. Nothing in the town can know or change it otherwise, and nothing here sets an adoption rate.
